title: Single student endpoint returns the supported student
ordered_steps: [{"order":1,"action":"GET /student","expected_result":"HTTP 200 with id 1, firstName Ramseh, and lastName Mishra."}]
expected_outcome: HTTP 200 with the supported student fields.

title: Student list endpoint returns four students
ordered_steps: [{"order":1,"action":"GET /students","expected_result":"HTTP 200 with a JSON list containing four students."}]

title: Student path endpoint echoes a numeric id
ordered_steps: [{"order":1,"action":"GET /students/{id}","expected_result":"HTTP 200 with the path id, firstName Ramsesh, and lastName Mishra."}]
expected_outcome: HTTP 200 with the supported path-id response.

title: Student query endpoint echoes a numeric id
ordered_steps: [{"order":1,"action":"GET /students/query?id={id}","expected_result":"HTTP 200 with the query id, firstName Ramesh, and lastName Mishra."}]
expected_outcome: HTTP 200 with the supported query-id response.

title: Student creation echoes the request body
test_data: ["Student JSON with id, firstName, and lastName"]
ordered_steps: [{"order":1,"action":"POST /students/create","expected_result":"HTTP 201 with id, firstName, and lastName echoed from the request body."}]
expected_outcome: HTTP 201 with the supported Student response fields.

title: Student update echoes the request names
test_data: ["id: numeric path value","Student JSON with firstName and lastName"]
ordered_steps: [{"order":1,"action":"PUT /students/{id}/update","expected_result":"HTTP 200 with firstName and lastName echoed from the request body."}]
expected_outcome: HTTP 200 with the supported updated name fields.

title: Student deletion returns the supported confirmation
ordered_steps: [{"order":1,"action":"DELETE /students/{id}/delete","expected_result":"HTTP 200 with exact body Student Successfully Deleted!."}]
expected_outcome: HTTP 200 with the exact supported confirmation body.
